description: This file defines the base class 'Module' for all neural network modules in PyTorch, including methods for registration, cloning, applying functions, serialization, and submodule management.

classes.name: torch::nn::Module
classes.description: The base class for all modules in PyTorch, providing an API for submodule registration, parameter management, serialization, and mode switching.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the module and its submodules, parameters, and buffers, optionally moving to a specified device.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies a function recursively to the module and its submodules, with multiple overloads accepting different function signatures.

methods.name: parameters
methods.description: Returns a vector of tensors representing the parameters of the module, optionally including submodules.

methods.name: named_parameters
methods.description: Returns an ordered dictionary of parameter names and tensors, including submodules if recurse is true.

methods.name: buffers
methods.description: Returns a vector of tensors representing the buffers of the module, optionally including submodules.

methods.name: named_buffers
methods.description: Returns an ordered dictionary of buffer names and tensors, including submodules if recurse is true.

methods.name: modules
methods.description: Returns a vector of shared pointers to all submodules, including self if include_self is true.

methods.name: named_modules
methods.description: Returns an ordered dictionary of module names and submodule pointers, with optional prefix and self inclusion.

methods.name: children
methods.description: Returns a vector of shared pointers to direct child modules.

methods.name: named_children
methods.description: Returns an ordered dictionary of direct child module names and pointers.

methods.name: train
methods.description: Sets the module and its submodules to training mode.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Sets the module and its submodules to evaluation mode.

methods.name: is_training
methods.description: Returns true if the module is in training mode.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Recursively casts parameters and buffers to specified device and dtype.

methods.name: zero_grad
methods.description: Zeros out the gradients of all registered parameters.

methods.name: as
methods.description: Attempts to cast the module to a specific derived type.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes the module into an output archive.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Deserializes the module from an input archive.

methods.name: pretty_print
methods.description: Outputs a human-readable representation of the module hierarchy.

methods.name: is_serializable
methods.description: Returns whether the module can be serialized.

methods.name: register_parameter
methods.description: Registers a tensor as a parameter of the module.

methods.name: register_buffer
methods.description: Registers a tensor as a buffer of the module.

methods.name: register_module
methods.description: Registers a submodule with the module, with overloads for raw shared_ptr and ModuleHolder.

methods.name: replace_module
methods.description: Replaces an existing submodule with a new one, with overloads for raw shared_ptr and ModuleHolder.

methods.name: unregister_module
methods.description: Removes a submodule by name, throwing if not found.
